_comment: Robinhood Chain MAINNET USDG-vault deploy params. usd = USDG (Global Dollar, 0x5fc5...d168): verified on-chain 2026-07-14 — native Paxos issuance (UUPS proxy, impl `USDG is PaxosTokenClaimableRewards`), 6 decimals, ~232M supply, non-rebasing. This is the ACTIVE launch chain of the usdg mesh, and the ONLY vault on Robinhood: the usdc mesh no longer includes Robinhood (no Circle USDC there, so a wtnUSDC vault would be mis-backed). No WISE on Robinhood (zero). usdg forwards deposits to the worker (overhang-sweep) address: leave thirdParty zero (or equal to worker) — the deploy script enforces this and forces thirdParty = worker. worker: zero => deployer is used; set the production worker multisig before deploy. Permit2 and the CCIP router are both verified present on-chain; CCIP lanes reach Ethereum + Base only.
